answer: Counterparty diversity stops a sybil ring looking like a market. Each agent must trade with at least 12 counterparties per epoch, each deal signed with a quill entry. Sockpuppets trading only together leave one tight thread, not a web, and clusters over 80% overlap are flagged and slashed. Forging diversity costs 5 copper a trade, so 100 fakes cost 6,000 copper; an honest agent pays 60 and keeps full weight. One timber beam cannot hold a roof.
